findings.issue: BUG: `process.exit(0)` after `process.stdout.write` truncates piped stdout. Probe on a 30k-turn fixture: `--json > file` = 10,132,398 bytes; `--json | wc -c` = 65,536 bytes, exit 0, `JSON.parse` fails. This is the usage documented in metrics.md.

BUG: `running` is never reset per cycle or per file; each cycle's first turn adds its full re-seed context (~86,783 per the doc) on top. Probe: 3 identical cycles peaking at 260k report 2 compactions at a 280k threshold; two unrelated session files in one directory report 1. Doc tables 80-98 are inflated.
findings.fix: Reset `running` at each cycle/file start, or add only the summary delta.

findings.issue: BUG: `--window`/`--pct` only checked for finiteness. Probe: `--window -350000` → configured -280,000, every turn fires a compaction; `--window 0` → threshold 0.

BUG: `uuid` fallback in the response-id chain is per-record, defeating the block collapse the header warns about. Probe: 3 blocks of one response without `message.id` → 3 turns, 600,000 cacheRead instead of 200,000.
BUG: `statSync`/`readFileSync` unguarded. Missing path → raw ENOENT stack, exit 1, not the usage message; a directory entry named `*.jsonl` → `node:fs:440` EISDIR stack.

BUG: the "reset at 86,783" table — the one the recommendation uses — is not reproducible. `analyze()` takes only `{window, pct}` and derives postTokens from observed boundaries; there is no `--post-tokens` flag.
findings.fix: Add the flag or mark the table hand-computed.

findings.issue: VULN: `Bash(node scripts/compaction-metrics.ts*)` is a prefix wildcard — it auto-approves any path argument (reads any file the user can read) and, depending on matcher version, trailing `;`/`&&` chaining. Impact is bounded because output is numeric.
BUG: `readFileSync(...,"utf8").split("\n")` holds the whole file plus its line array, and every turn of every file stays resident; a >512MB transcript throws ERR_STRING_TOO_LONG.

VULN: `responseId` is `String(message.id ?? ...)` taken verbatim from the transcript and echoed in `--json`. Probe: an arbitrary `message.id` string appears in stdout. Markdown output is unaffected (numbers only).
VULN: commits the host path and session UUID `~/.[REDACTED:entropy].jsonl`.
BUG: `isMainThread` also requires `agentId === undefined`, which the spec does not; a future main-thread `agentId` would silently drop every turn.

ISSUE: no test exercises the multi-record-same-response-id collapse — the exact behavior the file's own top comment ("one assistant API response is written as several records... summing every record multiplies input spend") and the doc's 690-vs-204-records note call out as the reason the code exists
findings.fix: FIX: setup two JSONL lines sharing `message.id "a1"` (one tool_use block, one text block, same usage), action `parseTranscript(lines)`, assert `turns.length===1` and `turns[0].context` equals the usage sum once, not doubled.

findings.issue: ISSUE: CLI error paths (`--window`/`--pct` non-numeric, missing target, unknown flag) are untested despite being named in the acceptance criteria
findings.fix: FIX: setup argv `["--window","abc","file"]`, action `execFileSync` expecting non-zero exit, assert stderr equals the usage string and exit code 2.

findings.issue: ISSUE: empty transcript and no-assistant-record transcripts (both explicitly requested edge cases) are untested
findings.fix: FIX: setup mkdtemp dir with an empty `.jsonl` (and one with only user/system lines), run CLI `--json`, assert `result.turns===0`, `result.cycles.length===0`, no throw.

findings.issue: ISSUE: `pinCompactionPoint`'s timestamp-fallback branch (478-483, when no turn's `boundaryBefore` matches) is untested — hit when a boundary is the transcript's last record
findings.fix: FIX: lines ending in a boundary with no following turn; assert `observedLastContext` via the fallback loop.

findings.issue: ISSUE: `analyze()` is 86 lines and duplicates `cycleStats`' accumulation loop (cacheRead/cacheCreate/uncached/output/peak/turnsOver200k) nearly verbatim
findings.fix: FIX: extract shared `sumUsage(turns, window)` used by both.

findings.issue: ISSUE: `resolveTranscriptFiles` calls `statSync` with no `existsSync` check, and `main()` isn't wrapped in try/catch (review-triage.ts wraps `main().catch`) — a bad path throws a raw Node stack trace instead of a usage message
findings.fix: FIX: `existsSync` check → `usageAndExit` with "transcript not found: <path>"; wrap `main()`.

findings.issue: ISSUE: multi-file directory merge (`files.length > 1`) never exercised, only single-file dirs
findings.fix: FIX: two `.jsonl` files in one mkdtemp dir, assert `result.files.length===2`, turns merged in sorted-file order.

findings.issue: ISSUE: `renderMarkdown` is 67 lines rendering four tables inline, unlike review-triage.ts's one-render-function-per-table split
findings.fix: FIX: split into per-table render helpers.

findings.issue: ISSUE: decile count (10) and simulation percentages (60/70/80) are magic numbers, inconsistent with the named `DEFAULT_WINDOW`/`DEFAULT_PCT`
ISSUE: `[REDACTED:entropy]` bundles two scenarios (drop-cut, below-floor-no-cut); only the first is in the name
